scope: Completeness check of feed additive application dossiers: dossier structure (three parts, one file per section), file format rules (searchable PDF, 30 MB, no security settings, file names, English), administrative documents, Section I summaries and the list of confidential parts, the Section II-V headings of the completeness checklist (Appendix B, following Annex II of Regulation (EC) No 429/2008), justified omissions, and the completeness-check timeline. Source: the 2018 public-consultation draft of EFSA's administrative guidance. The current guidance (EFSA Supporting Publication 2021:EN-6508, last updated 2025) replaced CD/DVD submission with the e-submission platform (ESFC) and adds the Transparency Regulation requirements (see the pre-submission arrangements). Verify file naming and structure against the current version.

entries.title: Dossier in three parts
entries.requirement: The dossier has three parts: administrative documents, technical dossier, confidential parts (the last only when confidentiality is requested).

guidance_anchors: The dossier should contain three distinct parts (administrative documents, technical dossier, confidential

guidance_anchors: The size of single documents should be limited to 30 MB

entries.title: No security settings

entries.title: No special characters in file names
entries.requirement: File and folder names must not contain \ / : * ? " < > | #.
entries.quote: File and folder names should not include special characters
guidance_anchors: File and folder names should not include special characters

entries.title: Confidential parts and their list

entries.title: Confidential information marked in the technical dossier
entries.requirement: Information requested to be confidential is marked (e.g. by font colour) in the technical dossier and not removed from it.

guidance_anchors: The information considered confidential should be evidenced (e.g. using a different font

entries.title: Section II: identity, characterisation, conditions of use, methods of analysis
entries.requirement: Section II covers 2.1 identity, 2.2 characterisation of the active substance/agent, 2.3 manufacturing process, 2.4 physico-chemical and technological properties, 2.5 conditions of use, 2.6 methods of analysis and reference samples.
